title: Search-Eval Dataset Manifest
description: Per-eval selection of which datasets are active and how each is scored. Lets a sector drop default query families that don't fit and add custom single-type datasets. The board, revenue model, and report iterate this manifest instead of the hardcoded 5 defaults.

type.description: For custom datasets: the relation type (mirrors the custom dataset file).

scoring.description: grade_recall = the default per-result 0-3 + catalog recall. relational = count-direction + set overlap vs counterpart. retrieval = is the expected product found, at what rank, with what title fidelity.

file.description: Custom dataset filename, relative to the assessment dir.
